response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT t.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM telescopes t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.observstation, o.overall_avg HAVING AVG(t.bandusagepct) > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the mean of bandusagepct across all telescope rows with a non-null value, not the mean of the per-station averages.
Stations are taken from the telescopes table, so only stations that have at least one telescope with a non-null bandusagepct appear.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the mean of the per-station averages, so each station counts equally regardless of how many telescopes it has.
alternatives.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS overall_avg FROM st) SELECT st.observstation, st.avg_bw AS avg_bandwidth_usage, st.avg_bw - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM st CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE st.avg_bw > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC LIMIT 10
